skill.name: session-handoff
skill.description: Create structured coding session handoff notes that record verified progress, decisions, changed files, unresolved tasks, and one precise next action.
skill.summary: Capture actionable project context before ending or resetting an AI coding session.

content.user_title: Preserve Coding Progress Across Agent Sessions
content.value_statement: Ending a long coding session can lose decisions, verified progress, and unresolved tasks. This skill organizes that context into a structured note for the next session.
actual_capabilities: Guide Git status and diff inspection to identify modified, untracked, and staged files.
Record the project goal, implemented state, verification commands, and unverified assumptions.
Document technical decisions, their reasons, and rejected approaches.
List changed files and relevant functions, classes, or schema definitions.
Assign unresolved tasks to a human or agent and specify verification criteria.
Provide a handoff template, one immediate next action, and a context hygiene checklist.
limitations: Produces written notes only; running processes and in-memory debugging state are not preserved.
Cannot recover decisions or changes that the outgoing session did not record.
Does not replace version control, issue tracking, or independent test verification.
Context thresholds are general guidance, not automatic measurements or guaranteed performance improvements.

use_cases.title: Pause Feature Development
use_cases.description: Record implemented behavior, changed files, and the next verification step before ending a coding session.

use_cases.title: Transfer Debugging Work
use_cases.description: Document failing checks, discarded hypotheses, and remaining tasks when another engineer takes over an investigation.

use_cases.title: Resume Repository Maintenance
use_cases.description: Capture migration dependencies, verified fixes, and unresolved release tasks before moving to a fresh agent session.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a session handoff note for the current task. Include the goal, verified progress, changed files, unresolved tasks, and one next action.

prompt_templates.title: Ground the Note in Workspace Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect Git status and diff statistics before drafting the handoff. Separate passing checks from unverified assumptions and list exact changed files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: reviewing a session with several edits.

prompt_templates.title: Capture an Unfinished Investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a debugging handoff with the current failure, rejected approaches, relevant symbols, task owners, verification criteria, and the first diagnostic action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: transferring a partial bug investigation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Constrained Session Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the handoff template before a context reset. Record architectural decisions, dependencies, human approvals, unverified assumptions, and one precise next action. Exclude secret values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: transferring work with dependencies and operational constraints.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff for a feature with passing unit tests and unfinished integration tests.
output: Goal: Complete the account settings update.
Current state: Input validation is implemented; the targeted unit tests passed.
Decision: Reuse the existing validation helper to keep behavior consistent.
Open task: Agent owns integration coverage; verify valid and invalid submissions.
Next action: Add the missing invalid-submission integration test.

output_examples.input: Summarize an interrupted investigation of duplicate background jobs.
output: Goal: Prevent duplicate jobs after retries.
Current state: A regression test reproduces duplicate insertion; the cause remains unverified.
Rejected approach: Increasing retry delays did not resolve the failure.
Open task: Agent investigates transaction boundaries; verify with the regression test.
Next action: Inspect the enqueue operation used by the failing test.
Watch-out: Do not change the configured retry limit during this investigation.

best_practices: Inspect current workspace changes and record exact verification results before drafting the note.
Use real file paths and symbols; assign each unresolved task an owner and a completion check.
Save the note before resetting context, exclude secret values, and keep the next action specific.
anti_patterns: Paste the full conversation instead of a focused handoff.
Mark work complete without running checks or labeling unverified assumptions.
Omit rejected approaches or finish with a vague continuation request.

faq.question: When should I create a handoff note?
faq.answer: Create one before ending a session, switching tasks, clearing context, or moving to another agent session.

faq.question: Which coding agents are mentioned?
faq.answer: The skill names Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. The workflow uses written notes rather than a dedicated agent integration.

faq.question: Does the skill preserve running processes?
faq.answer: No. Record important process details and debugging observations explicitly; the handoff preserves only written information.

faq.question: How does it distinguish facts from assumptions?
faq.answer: It records verification commands and results, and labels untested assumptions as unverified.

faq.question: Does a handoff replace commits or tickets?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends referencing version control and issue tracking rather than duplicating them.

faq.question: Should I include credentials in the note?
faq.answer: No. Record configuration requirements and responsible owners without including passwords, tokens, or secret values.
